## Batch 1 authored

The A page now contains the fixed-dimension open problem; the B page contains a fully verified center-point discrepancy example and a source-based comparison of the planar order with the differing \(d\ge3\) bounds. The formulation follows the published ordered-multiset, half-open-box convention. Both items have only the published discrepancy definition as a logical dependency and compute to dependency level 0.

The page files, source coverage, proof contract, notes, manifest, and empty cross-batch input are in place:

- [A item](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/op-optimal-star-discrepancy-order-dimension-at-least-three.md>)
- [B example](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/ex-one-point-star-discrepancy-center.md>)
- [Batch 1 notes](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-1.notes.md>)

The status review uses Owen’s [*Practical Quasi-Monte Carlo*](https://artowen.su.domains/mc/practicalqmc.pdf) and Dick’s [version 3 paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2607.23571v3). It treats Roth’s bound only as a classical baseline and explicitly limits the current-results search to a bounded review.

## Checks and blockers

The focused content-policy, dependency, rendering, coverage, manifest, source-fetch, precheck, proof-layout, and B-item contract checks passed. The two item levels are 0. Full-run dependency checking remains blocked by 131 empty inventories outside this batch and a separate level mismatch for `ex-ewald-source-collision-field-singularity`; it found no cycles.

The full strict proof-contract check cannot validate the open-problem item: [the validator branches on `item.kind`](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/tools/proof-contract.mjs:90>), but [its loader omits that field](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/tools/proof-contract.mjs:302>). The required `open_problem_review` is present; adding ordinary proof worksheets would violate the open-problem schema.

I attempted `step1-decisions record` for both items, but neither record was written: the tool cannot load the current run because [batch 40’s manifest](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-40.pages.json:627>) has malformed JSON at line 627, column 2. I left that unassigned file untouched. The B example passes its item-level checks; the open problem needs owner resolution of the validator mismatch. The run remains at `1-scaffold`; no engine state was changed.
